content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Research Associate - I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Research Associate - I.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate - I post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the Research Associate - I post is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for the Research Associate - I post by sending their application via Email.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree in life sciences. Experience in genomics including NGS is desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Research Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification for the Research Associate - I post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Research Associate - I at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate - I post primarily involves an Interview.

faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF by referring to the "Important Links" section of this article and clicking on the respective link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Research Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate - I position at AIIMS Delhi is a Project-based job type, funded by a DBT project.
